title: Compounding an offence
rule: The Director, or an officer authorised by Gazette notice, may settle an offence for money.
points: The offender must admit the offence in writing on the prescribed form.
The value of the produce or damage must not exceed TSh 2,000,000.
The sum is up to five times the maximum fine, plus fees and royalties due, the value of damaged produce, and expenses.
A receipt in the prescribed form is given and the action is reported. The money goes to the Fund.
Compounding is a defence to later charges.
